Set up. Sharing starts by itself in search hours.

FOLLO Tracks collects your phone's location, battery level and speed and sends them to Find Our Lost Loved Ones so search coordinators can see which ground has been covered and where searchers are.

This continues even when the app is closed or not in use, but FOLLO only keeps positions during declared search hours, inside the search area.

Next, Android asks for location access.
Android will ask next. Choose \"Allow all the time\" so tracking keeps going while the phone is in your pocket. FOLLO only keeps positions during search hours, inside the search area.
FOLLO Tracks records where you walk during a search so the team can see which ground is covered. Please allow precise location.
